name: Objets magiques des Royaumes Hauts Elfes
source: Warhammer: The Old World — High Elf Realms Magic Items

Armes magiques.name: Bow of the Seafarer
Armes magiques.notes: The Bow of the Seafarer shoots like a bolt thrower, using the Through & Through special rule.

Armes magiques.name: Star Lance
Armes magiques.notes: The Star Lance can only be used during a turn in which the wielder charged. In subsequent turns, or if the wielder did not charge, the model must use its hand weapon instead.

Armes magiques.name: Reaver Bow
Armes magiques.notes: The wielder may make a number of shooting attacks equal to their Attacks characteristic, rather than the usual one. This model does not suffer modifiers for firing multiple shots.

Armes magiques.name: Foe Bane
Armes magiques.notes: When the wielder makes a roll To Wound, a roll of 4+ is always a success, regardless of the target's Toughness.

Armures magiques.name: Armour of Stars
Armures magiques.notes: If struck by Killing Blow, the wearer is permitted armour and Regeneration saves as normal. If the wound is unsaved, they lose a single Wound.

Armures magiques.name: The Golden Shield
Armures magiques.notes: Any enemy model that directs its attacks against its bearer during the Combat phase must re-roll any rolls To Hit of a natural 6.

Armures magiques.name: Dragon Helm
Armures magiques.notes: The wearer improves their armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. In addition, its wearer has a 6+ Ward save against wounds caused by an attack with Flaming Attacks.

Talismans.name: Circlet of Atrazar
Talismans.notes: If the bearer's troop type is infantry or cavalry, they also have a +1 modifier to Toughness.

Talismans.name: Sacred Incense
Talismans.notes: Any enemy model that targets this character or any unit they have joined during the Shooting phase suffers an additional -1 To Hit modifier.

Talismans.name: The Loremaster's Cloak
Talismans.notes: The bearer and any unit they have joined has a 4+ Ward save against wounds caused by a Magic Missile.

Talismans.name: Opal Amulet
Talismans.notes: An Opal Amulet gives its bearer a 2+ Ward save against a single wound.

Bannières magiques.name: Banner of Arcane Protection
Bannières magiques.notes: Friendly units within 6" of the model carrying this standard gain Magic Resistance (-1).

Bannières magiques.name: The Banner of Lothern
Bannières magiques.notes: If the unit is equipped with thrusting spears, half of the models in the third rank or file, rounding up, can make supporting attacks.

Bannières magiques.name: Banner of Balance
Bannières magiques.notes: Whilst in base contact with a unit carrying the Banner of Balance, enemy units cannot re-roll any rolls To Hit or To Wound. However, nor can the unit carrying the Banner of Balance.

Bannières magiques.name: Lion Standard
Bannières magiques.notes: The unit automatically passes any Fear or Terror tests it is required to make.

Bannières magiques.name: Banner of Confidence
Bannières magiques.notes: The unit does not suffer the usual -1 To Hit modifier when making a Stand & Shoot charge reaction.

Objets enchantés.name: Null Stone
Objets enchantés.notes: Whilst within the Command range of the bearer, all Wizards, friend or foe, suffer a -1 modifier to their Casting and Dispel rolls. During the Command sub-phase, if not engaged in combat, the character may make a Leadership test using unmodified Leadership; if passed, until the next Start of Turn sub-phase, the character cannot be targeted by spells and is immune to their effects.

Objets enchantés.name: Amulet of the Tempest
Objets enchantés.notes: Whilst within 9" of the bearer, enemy Wizards cannot add their Level of Wizardry to Casting rolls.

Objets enchantés.name: The Cloak of Beards
Objets enchantés.notes: Other models cannot use the wearer's Leadership.

Objets enchantés.name: Gem of Courage
Objets enchantés.notes: Once per game, when required to make a Break test, the bearer and their unit may roll an extra D6 and discard the highest result.

Objets cabalistiques.name: The Vortex Shard
Objets cabalistiques.notes: A Wizard may use this instead of making a dispel attempt. The spell is automatically dispelled with no Dispel roll required. In addition, all Remains in Play spells currently in play are dispelled, including spells cast by friendly Wizards.

Objets cabalistiques.name: Sigil of Asuryan
Objets cabalistiques.notes: A Wizard may use this instead of making a dispel attempt. The spell is automatically dispelled with no Dispel roll required. A perfect invocation cannot be dispelled.

Objets cabalistiques.name: The Trickster's Pendant
Objets cabalistiques.notes: When attempting a Wizardly dispel, roll an extra D6 and discard the lowest result. If dispelled, the opposing Wizard cannot cast more spells for the remainder of the current turn. If a double 1 is rolled on any two dice rolled, the bearer is outclassed in the art.

Objets cabalistiques.name: Annulian Crystal
Objets cabalistiques.notes: Once per turn, upon successfully casting a spell, the bearer can choose to forget that spell and immediately generate another, not including signature spells, in the usual manner.

Objets cabalistiques.name: Silvery Wand
Objets cabalistiques.notes: This does not increase the Wizard's Level.

Objets cabalistiques.name: Staff of Solidity
Objets cabalistiques.notes: Once per game, when the bearer is required to roll on the Miscast table, they may choose not to.
